data.title: Spotting Made-Up Tales and Real Facts

excerpts.text: The clever red fox looked up at the crow sitting on a tall branch. The crow held a sweet golden chunk of cheese in her beak. Mr. Fox spoke sweet words to trick the bird into opening her mouth.
Honeybees are flying insects that live together in large groups called colonies. A single hive can hold thousands of worker bees. These insects visit many flowers every day to gather sweet nectar.
Long ago, people looked up at the night sky and drew pictures with the bright stars. They told stories about a great hunter who chased a giant bear across the dark heavens.
